name: Schneider AvatarOn 1-Gang Flush Switch, 16AX
short: Ultra-slim frameless switch with customisable faceplates and silver-nickel arc-suppression contacts.
desc: The AvatarOn BLYSS series redefines the flush switch with a near-flush rocker, tool-less customisable covers in finishes from champagne gold to matte black, and high-copper silver-nickel contacts engineered for zero arcing and decades of service.

name: Schneider AvatarOn 2-Gang Flush Switch, 10AX
short: Two-gang slim rocker with soft-click action and frameless surround.
desc: A two-gang member of the AvatarOn family with the same ultra-thin profile and tool-less faceplate system, ideal for bedrooms and living areas where multiple circuits are controlled from one point.

name: Clipsal Neo 13A Double Socket with 45W USB-C
short: British 13A outlet with integrated 45W fast-charge USB-C/A module.
desc: The Neo series pairs a classic British shuttered 13A duplex outlet with an intelligent 45W USB charger (USB-C + USB-A), shutting off heat and protecting devices with smart current sharing.

name: Clipsal Saturn 40 Series 13A DP Socket Outlet
short: Square-edge double pole outlet in a refined matt finish.
desc: Saturn 40A's gentle cam action and phosphor bronze earth clip deliver a socket that stays tight for life. Double-pole switching with neon indicator option.

name: Clipsal 30M Fan Regulator / Dimmer, 1000W
short: Electronic speed controller for ceiling fans and incandescent loads.
desc: A proven electronic regulator with soft-start and radio-suppression filtering, controlling up to 1000W of fan or lighting load from a standard flush box.

name: Riva Hotel Keycard Switch, 40A 250V
short: Energy-saving entry card switch for guest rooms.
desc: Insert the guest card at the entrance and the room comes alive; pull it on exit and every circuit drops to standby — cutting hotel energy bills by up to 30%. Adjustable 3–15 minute delay.

name: Clipsal Telephone / Data Outlet, Single Jazz
short: Modular RJ11/RJ45 outlet with screwless surround.
desc: Snap-in modular telecommunications outlet that takes RJ11 phone or RJ45 data inserts behind a single screwless plate, matching the Clipsal wiring range.

name: Clipsal E-Series 3-Gang Surround Plate
short: Classic screwless surround in gloss or matt finishes.
desc: The iconic square-cut E-Series surround clips over mechanisms without visible screws, available in dozens of colours and finishes to dress any switchline.

name: Coarts 48V Magnetic Track Spot Lighting System
short: Low-voltage magnetic rails with tool-free reconfigurable spots.
desc: A 48V magnetic track system for galleries, retail and residences: spots, flood bars and linear diffusers snap in and slide anywhere along the rail, with CRI 92+ optics and DALI/dimming drivers.

name: Coarts Ultra-Slim Recessed Downlight 12W
short: Barely-there ceiling downlight with anti-glare reflector.
desc: A deep-set, anti-glare LED downlight only 12mm proud of the ceiling, with a high-purity anodised reflector below UGR 19 — the archivist's choice for hotels and living rooms.

name: Coarts Architectural Linear Profile Light
short: Extruded aluminium profiles for cove and niche lighting.
desc: Surface, recessed and suspended anodised profiles with opal or micro-prismatic diffusers, turning tape LED into an architectural line of light for retail and residential coves.

name: Coarts UFO Highbay LED 150W, Industrial
short: High-output disc bay for warehouses above 8m.
desc: Die-cast aluminium UFO highbay with Osram/Osura-class chips, 150lm/W efficacy and IP65 shell, engineered for warehouses, factories and sports halls with mounting heights up to 12 metres.

name: Coarts LED Flood Light 100W, IP66
short: Weatherproof floodlight for façades, yards and signage.
desc: Tempered-glass IP66 floodlight with a wide-throw reflector and adjustable bracket — the standard choice for boundary walls, parking lots and outdoor signage across Pakistan's climate.

name: Coarts LED Street Light 80W, Road Optic
short: Type-II/III road optics for avenues and housing schemes.
desc: Asymmetric road optics push light down the carriageway instead of into bedroom windows. 80W model on a 60cm spigard with 10kV surge protection built in.

name: Coarts LED Pool Light 18W, IP68
short: Flush-mount underwater colour-change luminaire.
desc: IP68 underwater light in anti-corrosion housing with RGBW colour scenes, suitable for swimming pools, fountains and water features; 12V safe extra-low voltage.

name: Coarts Emergency Exit Sign, 3H Battery
short: Monitored maintained exit sign with 3-hour autonomy.
desc: LED exit sign with self-test and 3 hours of battery autonomy on mains failure, meeting commercial egress requirements for offices, retail and hospitality.

name: BlueDot Smart 4-Gang Scene Switch Panel
short: Capacitive glass panel with customisable scenes over Zigbee/Matter.
desc: A flush glass smart panel that replaces a conventional switchline: four relay channels plus scene buttons driving lighting, curtains and HVAC through Matter/Zigbee, with local failsafe operation.

name: BlueDot Wi-Fi Smart Plug with Energy Meter
short: Plug-in automation with live power monitoring and app control.
desc: Drop any appliance into the Smart Life / BlueDot app schedule, voice control and away mode, while the onboard meter tracks kWh so you can see exactly what that geyser really costs.

name: Ltech Smart Touch Switch Module, 2-Gang
short: Retrofit smart module behind your favourite designer plate.
desc: Ltech's flush relay modules keep the switch style you chose and add app, timer and automation control — a smarter take on renovation, with dry-contact outputs safe for any load.

name: Riva Ceiling Motion Sensor, 360° PIR
short: Hide-a-hole PIR occupancy for corridors and washrooms.
desc: A 360-degree ceiling PIR with 8m detection radius, adjusting time and lux thresholds on a dial, switching lighting or fan circuits only when — and where — people actually are.

name: BlueDot Motorised Curtain Track, Wi-Fi
short: Whisper-quiet opening and closing on schedule or scene.
desc: A silent belt-drive track that retrofits behind pelmets: voice, app, sun-schedule or "goodnight" scene, with manual pull-start and Type-C rechargeable options for glass runs to 7m.

name: Riva Guest Room Management System Kit
short: Card switch, door status and scene control in one hotel package.
desc: The complete GRMS head-end for hotel floors: keycard power switch, doorbell with DND function, iris card readers and thermostat integration that empties the room's energy when the guest leaves.

name: ABB S200 MCB 1-Pole C16, 10kA
short: The industry-reference miniature breaker with 10kA breaking.
desc: ABB's System pro M compact S200 sets the bar for final-circuit protection: 10kA breaking capacity, clearly marked trip indicators and a contact position display you can trust in every DB.

name: ABB S200 MCB 4-Pole C32, 10kA
short: Four-pole protection for three-phase sub-mains.
desc: A 4-pole C32 S200 protecting three-phase circuits with neutral, DIN-rail mounted in distribution boards across commercial risers.

name: Himel HDM3 MCCB 250A 3-Pole, 35kA
short: Molded case breaker for incomers and heavy feeders.
desc: The Himel HDM3 series delivers thermal-magnetic molded case protection with 35kA breaking at 415V — the dependable incomer choice for factories and building distribution.

name: ABB AF09-AF38 AF-T Series Contactors
short: Three-phase contactors for motors, capacitor banks and lighting.
desc: ABB's AF range runs cool and quiet across motor, capacitor-switching and lighting duties with Wide Range power supplies that shrug off coil-voltage dips.

name: Himel Thermal Overload Relay JRS1
short: Direct-on-line motor overload protection with trip display.
desc: Clip-on thermal overload with adjustable current band, manual/auto reset and phase-loss sensitivity — the bodyguard behind every DOL motor starter.

name: PCE Motor Protection Circuit Breaker 63A
short: Combined magnetic + thermal protection and isolation for motors.
desc: PCE's MPCB integrates short-circuit and overload protection with a lockable isolating handle, stopping 500V-class motors from burning a winding.

name: ABB RPFS Automatic Power Factor Controller + Capacitors
short: Kill K-factor penalties with staged capacitor banks.
desc: APFC panel components: RPFS controller, detuned reactors and LV capacitors that hold plant power factor above 0.99 and free up transformer capacity.

name: Himel 8-Way IP54 Consumer Unit with Busbar
short: Domestic distribution board, surface or flush mount.
desc: Powder-coated steel DB with microswitch door, DIN busbar and SPBO main — tidy, safe and expandable distribution for homes and small offices.

name: VTEKE NH00 HRC Fuse Links, 63A aM
short: Indicator-type blade fuse links for distribution protection.
desc: Colour-coded (red) all-range blade fuse links with striking indicator, for distribution boards and DB fuseways up to 500V a.C.

name: PCE Merz Three-Phase Digital Energy Meter (DIN)
short: DIN-rail revenue-grade metering with RS-485 output.
desc: A wide-direct-connection three-phase meter class 1.0 (active) on DIN rail, logging kWh, kVA, PF and harmonics with Modbus RTU for BMS integration.

name: 16A 5-Core Industrial Plug & Socket, IP44
short: Colour-coded pin & sleeve connectors for plant and workshops.
desc: IEC 60309 pin-and-surface in 16A 5-pin 415V (red): shrouded pins, grommet strain relief and a splash-rated housing for workshop and yard supply points.

name: Tiandy 5MP AI Colour Maker Dome Camera
short: Full-colour night vision with AI human/vehicle classification.
desc: The TC-C35XN renders colour in near darkness with Starlight+ optics and filters alarms by human or vehicle at the edge, cutting the false positives that bury security desks.

name: Tiandy 4MP IR Bullet Camera, IP67
short: Weatherproof perimeter camera with 80m IR throw.
desc: A workhorse 4MP PoE bullet with deep-freeze IP67 housing and 80-metre infrared for boundaries, lanes and yards, day and night.

name: Tiandy 16-Channel AI NVR, 4-SATA
short: RAID-ready recorder with face and metadata search.
desc: Sixteen channels at up to 8K front-end, four SATA bays with RAID, and AI-accelerated search that finds the person, not the hour of footage.

name: Lockly Secure Pro SDD200 Digital Deadbolt
short: Biometric fingerprint lock with one-time-passcode access.
desc: Fingerprint, PIN, app and mechanical key in one deadbolt; unique one-time passcodes for guests and delivery, and an anti-peephole rotating PIN pad for front-door privacy.

name: Inter-M Villa Video Door Phone with 7" Monitor
short: See and release visitors from inside the home.
desc: Weatherproof wide-angle door station paired with a hands-free 7-inch colour monitor: night vision, remote unlock and snapshot to phone via optional module.

name: Schneider Actassi Cat6A Toolless Keystone Jack
short: 10Gbps shielded termination in 30 seconds, no tools.
desc: Actassi's toolless IDC keystone snaps cat6A shielded runs into place with a clear load bar and independent shield termination — fast field terminations that still pass certification.

name: Schneider Actassi 24-Port Cat6 Patch Panel, 1U
short: Loaded 1U panel with cable management comb.
desc: A 24-port keystone patch panel with hinged front door and rear cable manager — patch rooms stay labellable and bend-radius safe.

name: Schneider Actassi LC OM4 Fibre Trunk, 24-Core
short: Factory-terminated and tested multimode backbone.
desc: Pre-terminated LC-LC OM4 multi-fibre trunk with pull grip and strength member — inter-rack backbones in minutes, no fusion splicer required on site.

name: Schneider IT Rack 42U Glass Door with PDU
short: Soundproofed enclosed rack with basic PDU and fans.
desc: A 42U 800×800 enclosed rack: hardened glass front, ventilated rear door, tool-less side panels, pre-mounted 8-way PDU and a top fan tray for small server and NVR rooms.

name: GPON ONU Terminal, Gigabit Wi-Fi
short: Fibre-to-the-room terminal for building GPON networks.
desc: Class B+ SC/UPC GPON subscriber unit with GE + POTS ports and dual-band Wi-Fi for FTTB/FTTH riser designs in apartments and hotels.

name: Davis Tile-Type Floor Box, Power + Data
short: Levelling floor box for marble and tile floors.
desc: Zinc-alloy floor box with height-adjustable frame that levels to the tile, grommeted power and data openings, and a flip lid that lies flat against the floor.

name: Davis Carpet-Type Floor Box, 2-Module
short: Deep-floor box for raised carpet installations.
desc: Raised-floor distribution box with 100mm depth for carpet tiles, hinged metal lid and two snap-in service outlets.

name: Eubiq SL001 Floor Box Security Lock
short: Keyed lock keeps public-area floor boxes closed.
desc: A retrofit cam-lock that keeps floor-box lids shut in malls, lobbies and classrooms — only facilities staff with the controlled key get access.

name: Surface Power Track, 3m with 6 Adapters
short: Expandable busbar trunking for workshops and boardrooms.
desc: Aluminium surface trunking with a solid copper busbar: slide in 13A, USB or data adapters wherever the desk plan demands — move them tomorrow without an electrician.

name: Audio Control Architect P-65 In-Ceiling Speaker (Pair)
short: Slim-bezel custom-install ceiling speakers for zones.
desc: The Architect series' 6.5" two-way ceiling loudspeaker: pivoting woofer, paint-safe micro-bezel grille and a sound clean enough to be the main pair in a media room.

name: Q Acoustics M40 Soundbar with Bluetooth
short: Slim 3.1-channel bar with wireless sub input.
desc: Forty watts driving five long-throw drivers and two PQL passive radiators; pairs over aptX Bluetooth or eARC, and expands with the Q 3050 wireless subwoofer.

name: KEF Q100 Uni-Q Bookshelf Speakers (Pair)
short: Point-source Uni-Q detail in a compact cabinet.
desc: KEF's famous Uni-Q driver puts the tweeter in the woofer's acoustic centre, so vocals stay fixed in the room wherever you sit. FlexWave and bass-reflect ports adapt it to wall placement.

name: Dynaudio Focus 20 XR Floor-Standing Speakers
short: Danish active wireless floorstanders with streaming built in.
desc: Focus XR fuses Dynaudio's landmark passive acoustics with DSP-driven amps and full streaming — Wi-Fi, AirPlay 2, and room calibration that makes the speakers disappear.

name: Audio Control 10" In-Wall Subwoofer
short: Architectural bass that lives inside the wall.
desc: A high-excursion 10" in-wall subwoofer with a sealed back can, so cinema rumble stays in the wall cavity — ideal for slim home-cinema builds where floor space is luxury.

name: Russound Mpx.av6 Multi-Room Controller + Amplifier
short: Six zones of audio and video from one rack unit.
desc: The Mpx series puts streaming sources, keypads and touch-control into a single 6-zone controller — the backbone of whole-home and hospitality audio.

name: Lyngdorf TCD-2160 RoomPerfect Amplifier/Processor
short: Room-corrected digital amplification, 2 × 60W class-D.
desc: Lyngdorf's RoomPerfect calibration rebuilds your speakers' response for the actual room, then drives them with pure digital class-D — no DAC in the signal path at all.

name: 4K UHD Media Player with HDR10+
short: Local-library playback for the dedicated home cinema.
desc: A reference 4K60 HDR10+/Dolby Vision player that rips, organises and streams your disc library to the projector with frame-accurate seeking and 7.1 bitstream passthrough.

name: Clipsal Saturn 6-Way Surge Extension Board, 3m
short: Heavy-duty 13A block with surge protection and overload cut-off.
desc: Six shuttered 13A outlets on a 3m HRCR cable behind a surge-protected, resettable-circuit-breaker steel block — office-grade power distribution.

name: Khind 18" High-Speed Wall Fan with Remote
short: Oscillating industrial-style wall fan, copper motor.
desc: Khind's Q-Home 18-inch wall fan throws wide cooling airflow with 9 speeds, sleep mode and a fully oscillating head on a powder-coated arm.

name: Heavy-Duty 8" Bathroom Exhaust Fan
short: Quiet shuttered extractor for washrooms and geyser areas.
desc: An 8-inch inline extractor with auto-shutter backdraft damper, corrosion-treated blades and the kind of quiet that keeps it running after the shower ends.

name: Motorised Popup Desk Socket, 13A + HDMI + USB
short: Touch-launch power and AV from the boardroom table.
desc: A silent motorised lift for boardrooms and executive desks: two 13A sockets, USB-C/A and an HDMI flap rise at a tap and close flush with the joinery.

name: Wireless Door Chime Kit, 43 Ringtones
short: No-wire push button plus plug-in chime.
desc: Expand the front-door call to every floor in ten minutes: an IP44 wireless button, a plug-in receiver with 43 melodies, five volumes and a flash-led mode.

name: UV Mosquito Killer Lamp, Chemical-Free
short: Suction-trap UV for bedrooms and lobbies.
desc: A 365nm UV LED draws mosquitoes into a whisper-quiet vortex fan where they dehydrate in the tray — no zapping noise, no chemicals, washable tray.

name: 20A DP AC Isolator Switch with Neon
short: The neat, lockable power point for every split AC.
desc: A double-pole 20A rotary isolator with neon indicator and 3mm visible contact gap, giving air conditioners a safe, serviceable isolation point.

name: IP66 Weatherproof Switch & Socket Combo, Outdoor
short: Gasket-sealed cover plate for balconies and boundary walls.
desc: A 16A switch + 13A outlet behind a clear hinged weatherproof lid with foam gasket — monsoon-rated protection for exterior lighting and power points.

name: Heavy-Gauge Steel Surface Back Box, 3-Gang
short: Powder-coated metal box for industrial surface wiring.
desc: A 1.2mm pressed-steel, powder-coated 3-gang surface box with knockouts on all faces — the tidy alternative to conduit-and-bend surface installs.

name: 20A Trailing Socket on 5m Rubber Flex
short: Job-site ready extension with shuttered outlet.
desc: A 20A heavy trailing socket — shuttered outlet, 5m of 3-core 2.5mm² rubber flex and a moulded plug with strain grip, ready for plant rooms and fit-outs.

name: IP44 Maintained-Action Switch, Workshop Grade
short: Robust splash-proof switch for garages and stores.
desc: A sealed rocker switch maintaining IP44 against dust and splashes with 16A contacts — the workshop, garage and store light switch that survives its environment.
